apiKey.title: Gemini API Key
apiKey.desc: Live call correction, AI partner chat, call analysis and intermediate grammar lessons run on your own free Gemini key. Daily words and most grammar lessons work even without it.
apiKey.keyLooksOff: This doesn't look like a complete Gemini key yet — received {len} characters starting with “{prefix}”. A Gemini key is exactly 39 characters and starts with AIza.
apiKey.unexpectedResponse: The server returned an unexpected response — please try again.
apiKey.storageDown: ⚠️ Server storage is down — keys won't persist
apiKey.safety1: Stored server-side with AES-256-GCM encryption — never shared with anyone
apiKey.safety2: Only usable with your device ID; all AI calls are rate-limited
apiKey.safety3: The key never returns to your browser — you only see a masked preview (AIza…9f2)

studio.title: Library content studio
studio.subtitle: Learners read everything free — a Gemini key is only needed when they ask questions
studio.tokenHint: Needed to add or delete content. Paste the owner token here once — it unlocks every admin card (Studio, Storage, TURN). No Vercel setup needed.
studio.needToken: Enter the admin token above first
studio.empty: Nothing here yet — add your first entry with the form below.
studio.confirmDelete: Delete this entry? Learners will no longer see it.
studio.vWordHint: Submitting the same word + level again updates it
studio.vExamplesHint: One per line: English sentence = Bengali translation
studio.vExamplesPh:
Take it easy = ধীরে হও, চিন্তা করো না
Relax = শান্ত হওয়া
studio.vTipPh: Use Relax to calm a friend down…
studio.gTopicHint: Submitting the same topic + level again updates it
studio.gSectionsHint: Start each section with '##', then the Bengali explanation; wrong => right => why lines are split on '=>'.
studio.gSectionsPh:
## কখন 's' যোগ হয়
Third person singular-এ (he/she/it) verb-এর সাথে s যোগ হয়।
She go to school => She goes to school => Third person singular-এ s যোগ হয়
studio.gTipsPh: Use it to build a morning habit
studio.gFallback: If English/Hindi is left empty, learners see the Bengali text
studio.lTitleHint: The English title becomes the story's link slug; submitting the same title again updates it
studio.lParagraphsHint: English paragraphs — one blank line between each
studio.lVocabHint: One per line: word = Bengali meaning = English example sentence
studio.lQuizHint: One question per line: question(Bengali) | option1 | option2 | option3 | option4 | correct number(0-3) | explanation
studio.errSections: Add at least one section — a '##' heading with an explanation or examples
studio.setupUnlocked: Admin unlocked — Content Studio is ready in Settings.
studio.rSlugHint: Generated from the English title — or set your own here
studio.rJsonHint: Paste JSON in the format above: title/summary/genre/paragraphs(en+bn+hi)/vocabulary/quiz
studio.errReadingJson: Provide valid JSON — it needs a title and at least one paragraph
